topic.title: Introduction
topic.shortdesc: An introduction to DITA-to-EPUB transformation and the capabilities of modern publishing systems.

body.p: The transformation of structured content from DITA to EPUB represents a critical capability in modern technical communication workflows.

section.title: What is DITA?
section.p: DITA (Darwin Information Typing Architecture) is an XML-based architecture for authoring, producing, and delivering technical information. Key characteristics include:

ul.li: Topic-based authoring: Content is organized into discrete, reusable topics
Structured markup: Semantic elements provide meaning and structure
Content reuse: Topics can be reused across multiple publications
Conditional processing: Content can be filtered based on attributes

section.title: What is EPUB3?
section.p: EPUB3 is the third major revision of the EPUB (Electronic Publication) standard, offering:

ol.li: HTML5 and CSS3 support for rich content presentation
Enhanced accessibility features compliant with WCAG guidelines
Support for multimedia and interactive content
